# zcat

Decompress gzip files to standard output through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/zcat input.txt.gz

moonx cli/zcat first.gz second.gz > combined.txt
```

Read file operands or stdin, decode consecutive gzip members and write their contents to stdout.

## Notes

- Checksums are verified. A corrupt later member may fail after earlier decompressed bytes have already been written.

Build from source with the MoonBit 1.0 RC1 toolchain.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
